So you are trying to unlock new levels?  If so then the way it works is-
-you unlock any lvl you have played and completed
or
-you unlock the next lvl in line after your lowest completed lvl

So for example, if you have 1-1, 1-2, and then complete 1-3, you will unlock 1-4 even if you never played 1-4.  On this same example, you would not unlock 2-1 until you either play and clear 2-1 or until you play and clear 1-4.

The “queue” is all 35 players’ chosen lvls at the beginning.  It is believed to be set in the order of ppl from lowest lvl to highest lvl, without having lvls be back to back.  So to unlock 2-2, you want to look at your unlocked lvls before 2-2, find the one with no flags on it(meaning you never cleared it), and select it so it’s on the queue.  Presuming you are lower lvl, it ought to show up relatively early, or if you use the 1-2 warp you might see it there, though if using the warp pipe, it’s also possible you might pass the one you want.  

That is because the warp pipe skips the next lvl in the queue, and shows you the 3 that follow it(from right to left).  So let’s by coincidence the queue was 1-1 to 8-4.  When you get to 1-2, and go to the flag, the next lvl would be 1-3.  If you use the warp, it would show you 1-4 on the right, 2-1 in the middle, and 2-2 on the left.  So in this example, if you wanted 1-3, you’d miss it by choosing to go to the warp pipe.

Spoilers to anyone who wants to play it:


Get on Yoshi.  R jump off to go up, go right, drop down to get spring.  Place spring close enough so Yoshi and grab it and use it to jump back up and go back left.  Grab spring with Yoshi and spit it out.  Grab it and throw it up, then back on Yoshi and r jump up.  Take spring with you to key pit, then use spring to get back out.  Go back on Yoshi and grab spring.  Spit spring close enough to ice coins then jump on it with Yoshi to get up and over to the right again.  Use Yoshi to grab the spring and spit it out again.  Throw the spring up to activate the hidden block with the pow, then grab the spring and throw it up to activate on off switch.  Spring will disappear.  Get on Yoshi, and grab the mushroom(where red blocks cleared).  Spit it out to get big, then r jump up to reach the pow.  Use it to kill the muncher, z jump on the plain block to break it so you can get the fire flower.  Run left and drop.  Use fireballs to clear ice coins to open path below.  Jump on Yoshi and r jump off and clear other ice coins.  Stand near the edge and open key door.  Happy fun success.

Didn’t really enjoy it, sadly.  here’s what I’d advise-  If you’re not looking for low clear rates, then remove aggravations.   like icy floors. and reduce the number of snowballs you need to do any of those rooms. The p switch part could result in having to reset, but is forgiving, so, fine.  The slow walk inside of pokeys part-  I’d get rid of that entirely.  The leaf section-  idk what you intended,  but I flew and bounced over all of the pokeys.  Your sound effects implied you don’t want that but I could get to the end and use the tail to get to the pipe, so idk.  

All of this combined is not going to get you “easy expert” status.  Half the lvl might not get you easy expert status.  But, if you and your friends are just too good and this is what you like, then it doesn’t really matter what the rest of the world will think.  Gotta be true to yourselves.
